rationale: C18 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both orders establish a named national interdepartmental/advisory committee, provide for presidential designation of its leadership, enumerate its duties, and then use nearly identical language requesting every executive department and agency to cooperate and furnish available information required for those duties. C07 contains an almost identical cooperation clause and similar short committee-order architecture, but its membership and functions are less closely developed. C03 closely parallels the representative-and-alternate membership machinery, but its operative mission and support provisions diverge more substantially.

shared_material.child_excerpt: There is hereby established the Interdepartmental Committee on Narcotics ... The Chairman of the Committee shall be designated by the President
shared_material.parent_excerpt: There is hereby established the National Advisory Committee on the Selection of Doctors, Dentists, and Allied Specialists ... the chairman of which shall be designated by the President.
shared_material.explanation: Closely parallel establishment and presidential-chair-designation machinery, adapted to a different committee and subject.

shared_material.child_excerpt: All executive departments and agencies of the Government are requested to cooperate with the said Committee and to furnish it such available information as it may require for the performance of its duties
shared_material.parent_excerpt: All executive departments and agencies of the Federal Government are requested to cooperate with the Committee and to furnish it such available information as it may require for the performance of its duties.
shared_material.explanation: This is essentially verbatim shared operative language and is the strongest evidence of direct template reuse.

shared_material.child_excerpt: one representative of each of the Departments ... The head of each such department and agency shall designate the representative thereof, and shall also designate an alternate representative.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Council shall be composed of one qualified representative of each of the several executive departments and agencies ... Such representatives shall be designated by the heads of the respective departments and agencies, who may also designate suitable alternate representatives.
shared_material.explanation: C03 provides a close parallel for the child’s agency-representative and alternate-designation structure, supporting its third-place ranking.
